title: Poblaciones y territorios
goal: Read how censuses, conscription, and locally-imposed authorities integrated once-autonomous rural regions into the reach of the national state for the first time.

items: Explain what had changed about interior regions thanks to the railroad.
State what rural communities could no longer do without state involvement.
Explain what let young peasants and indigenous men no longer escape conscription.
Describe what most countries in the region carried out for the first time in these decades.
Use ya no to mark the end of a previous situation.
